name: Marco Rubio

source.title: File:Official portrait of Secretary Marco Rubio (cropped)(2).jpg — Wikimedia Commons

current_role: U.S. Secretary of State (since January 2025) and National Security Adviser (acting from May 2025, made permanent September 22, 2026)
summary: Marco Rubio is a Florida Republican who was Speaker of the Florida House (2006–2008) and a U.S. senator (2011–2025). He co-wrote the 2013 bipartisan Gang of Eight immigration bill, which Jeff Sessions led the fight against, and ran for president in 2016 against Donald Trump. Confirmed 99–0 as secretary of state on Trump's first day back in office, he also took over as national security adviser in May 2025, the first person to hold both jobs since Henry Kissinger.
